name: Fruit bat (Paniki)
description: a fruit bat (flying fox) in flight, front view, with TWO LARGE outstretched leathery wings
subject: biology

caption.en: A fruit bat (paniki) seen from the front in flight, with two large outstretched leathery wings spread wide.
caption.tl: Isang paniki (fruit bat) na nakita mula sa harap habang lumilipad, na may dalawang malaking nakaunat na balat-pakpak na nakakalat nang malawak.
caption.bis: Usa ka paniki (fruit bat) nga gitan-aw sa atubangan samtang naglupad, adunay duha ka dagkong mikaylap nga panit-pako nga nabuklad og layo.
